'''WRATH''' was the code-name of a highly skilled and accomplished [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] special agent who was charged with tracking down and disrupting the activities of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Privateer/Legends|Privateer]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]''. In order to accomplish this, WRATH followed the ''Far Orbit'' and directed Imperial agents to raid locations where the ''Far Orbit'' had recently visited. The goal of this tactic was to raise suspicions amongst the fringe elements of society from which the ''Far Orbit'' had garnered support, thus cutting the privateer's support network.

WRATH was characterized by his relentless, merciless devotion to his assignment.
